object.attr: analysis: review Q3 and the failure analysis's change to this requirement (CF-V11, CF-V12). object.description: If a file the commit takes from the working copy differs from what Mellon validated, other than by the commit dialog's author and date edit, Mellon shall refuse the commit and name the file.
